title: Allows finite values when max_digits=0
detail: When max_digits=0 and decimal_places=0, whole=0 and places=0, this line adds an alternative that matches '0.0' (or similar), violating the requirement that no finite decimal should satisfy the constraints.

title: Serialization pattern accepts finite values when max_digits=0
detail: For max_digits=0, this alternative matches '0' and '0.' which should be rejected because no finite decimal satisfies the constraints.

title: Variation selector at start causes index error
detail: When a variation selector (\ufe0f) appears at the beginning of the string, there is no previous span. The code attempts to modify spans[-1], which raises an IndexError. The intended behavior is to create a new span with zero width.
